name: symfony-agent-mcp
description: Read-only introspection of a Symfony codebase.
long_description:
Introspects a Symfony application without executing or writing anything: routes, controllers, services, entities, database schema, migrations, events, forms, security, Doctrine, Messenger, Twig, API Platform, testing, infrastructure and third-party integrations.

1,677 tools across 17 categories, discovered progressively. `tools/list` advertises five discovery meta-tools and the rest become callable once a category is activated, so connecting costs about 828 tokens instead of the ~154,000 that advertising every schema would. Turn Progressive tool discovery off to advertise all of them at once.

Every tool takes the path to a Symfony application root. The tools parse files and configuration only, and every result is scanned for credentials before it is returned.

dynamic_tools.title: Progressive tool discovery
dynamic_tools.description: Leave on and the server advertises five discovery meta-tools; the other 1,672 become callable once you activate a category, so connecting costs ~828 tokens instead of ~154,000. Turn off to advertise every tool up front.

token_budget.title: Token budget
token_budget.description: Ceiling for the tool schemas a session may have active at once.

allowed_paths.title: Allowed paths
allowed_paths.description: Colon-separated list of directories the server may read, e.g. /srv/app:/srv/other. Any path outside them is refused. Left empty, no allowlist is enforced.

session_secret.title: Session secret
session_secret.description: Set to require a session token on every call. Left empty, authentication is off.

audit_log.title: Audit log
audit_log.description: Encrypted log of every tool call.
